patterns.title: Project JDBC reader materialises a large result set
patterns.description: The project-specific JDBC reader appears in the retaining stack and should be checked for unbounded result-set materialisation.
fixes: Add a row-count guard before appending rows to the in-memory result.
Stream rows through the comparison pipeline instead of returning one fully materialised collection.
Reject or warn on broad production queries that do not include an explicit bound.
